glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.10 to 3721.18 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Resident" means a resident or a patient of a home.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.10 to 3721.18 of the Revised Code:
As used in sections 3721.10 to 3721.18 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Sponsor" means an adult relative, friend, or guardian of a resident who has an interest or responsibility in the resident's welfare.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.10 to 3721.18 of the Revised Code:
As used in sections 3721.10 to 3721.18 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (F) "Physical restraint" means, but is not limited to, any article, device, or garment that interferes with the free movement of the resident and that the resident is unable to remove easily, a geriatric chair, or a locked room door.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.10 to 3721.18 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (G) "Chemical restraint" means any medication bearing the American hospital formulary service therapeutic class 4:00, 28:16:08, 28:24:08, or 28:24:92 that alters the functioning of the central nervous system in a manner that limits physical and cognitive functioning to the degree that the resident cannot attain the resident's highest practicable physical, mental, and psychosocial well-being.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.10 to 3721.18 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (H) "Ancillary service" means, but is not limited to, podiatry, dental, hearing, vision, physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, and psychological and social services.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.10 to 3721.18 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (I) "Facility" means a facility, or part of a facility, certified as a nursing facility or skilled nursing facility, both as defined in section 5165.01 of the Revised Code. "Facility" does not include an intermediate care facility for individuals with intellectual disabilities, as defined in section 5124.01 of the Revised Code.
